pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit a primarily sub-polygonal geometry with relatively smooth edge gradients. Patches on the lower neck and shoulder occupy a larger relative spatial area compared to the more compressed patches on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light pelage pathways form a continuous topological lattice. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Corridor thickness is consistent across the neck and upper shoulder, while significantly narrowing into a fine branching network on the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour. The silhouette is composed of fine, vertically oriented pixel structures visible against the background along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized dendritic branching of light corridors on the posterior flank creates a high-density sub-network of narrow pathways not observed on the neck or mid-flank.
